title_as_printed: Experimental CO2 solubilities: microgasometric determinations of K0 in moles/l atm
pressure_note: not stated as a column; K0 is defined per atmosphere of CO2 FUGACITY (K0 = [CO2]/f_CO2, mol per litre of solution per atm; text eq. 2/5) and was obtained from microgasometric equilibration of degassed water with pure CO2; measured total pressure not tabulated. Values corrected by the author for CO2 non-ideality (virial EOS) and for dissociation (distilled water measurements). Constant P is the normalisation (K0 per 1 atm CO2 fugacity, p.205: 'when the total pressure and the fugacity are both 1 atm'; measurements 'at pressures near 1 atm'), not a measured total pressure.

value.what: CO2 solubility coefficient K0 = [CO2]/f_CO2, mol per litre of solution at the measurement temperature per atm fugacity; printed value is K0 x 10^2

composition.other_species: salinity > 0 rows are evaporated La Jolla surface seawater, filtered, HgCl2-poisoned, acidified with H2SO4 to pH 2.2 (acid neglected in salinity); salinity measured by inductive salinometer (+-0.004 permil) and adjusted gravimetrically; salinity 0.0 rows are distilled water, not acidified

conversion_needs: K0 in mol/L solution/atm fugacity to mole fraction or molality needs solution density and CO2 fugacity/total pressure basis (not tabulated)
salinity in permil of seawater matrix (printed as per-mille sign)
notes: Header in the printed table is K0 * 10^2 (the text layer printed 10^5, which is wrong). The table caption says K0 in moles/l atm; with x10^2 the values (e.g. 3.84e-2 mol/L atm at 20.6 C) agree with the paper's Table II. Property set to other: K0 = [CO2]/f_CO2 in mol per litre of solution per atm fugacity is not a Henry constant f/x (Table IV caption p.211; p.205); needs a dedicated converter (K0 -> molality via solution density).
volume_basis_evidence: p.205: K0 'referring to a liter of solution at the temperature of the measurement and an atmosphere fugacity'
